verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can challenge CodeRabbit's recommendations in chat (docs-6). Preferences taught through natural-language chat become 'learnings' that are applied automatically to future reviews (docs-7, docs-51), matching the 'learns from your team's feedback' claim (docs-1). A community reply only hedges that it 'supposedly' remembers (comm-4), which is skepticism rather than a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that rejected feedback actually stops recurring, and detailed docs on how learnings are scoped and managed.
